main_text.l: Addinga agri Rector videretur, ad hæc
fœdus inierunt anno M. CCCC. XLVII.:
nia ex formula ea, qua cum civitate hi,
qui in Præfectura vetere ad Dullartum
sunt, anno M. CCCC. XXXV. pepigerant.

l.i: Expresse vero cautum, si judices Territo-
rii (hi XII erant a populo & e populo electi)
inique judicasse putarentur, liceret læso [?] se-
natum Groninganum appellare intra dies X;
senatui jus esset, citare judices, & causam
tem temere, vel inique judicasse deprehen-
sos in marcas veteres V condemnare: At-
que hæc omnia salvo Eggonis & totius po-
puli jure, & libertate accepta à majoribus,
quatenus hujus fœderis capitibus non ad-

page.notes: Marginal note "Pafta cum Wefler woldin." is set in small italic type and is partly unclear; "woldin." is uncertain. Some words in the italic passage ("læso", "sententiâ suâ") are not certain and are marked [?]. The text breaks off at "e-" at the foot of the page; the continuation "jus" is the catchword, which is kept out of the text. The Roman numerals were printed in small capitals and are rendered as capitals.
